name: video-generation
description: Video generation skills for automated AI narration and short-form commentary video production.

interface.shortDescription: 用于影视和短剧解说视频的 AI 旁白工作流。
interface.longDescription: Video Generation packages skills for creating AI-assisted video outputs. The initial skill imports NarratorAI-Studio/narrator-ai-cli-skill, which guides agents through built-in movie materials, BGM, dubbing voices, narration templates, script generation, clip data, video composing, and optional visual templates through the narrator-ai-cli command-line tool.
defaultPrompt: Create an AI movie narration video with Narrator AI.
Show me the built-in movie materials for narration videos.
Guide me through BGM, dubbing, template, and video composing.
